info.title: Tags API
info.description: Organize your cloud resources with tags

post.description:
Create a tag that can be attached to cloud resources.

Values can be created along with the tag. A single request accepts at most
100 values.

Related commands:
  mgc tag values create --tag-name <name>  add more values to the tag
  mgc tag resources tags attach            attach the tag to a resource

post.description:
Attach one or more tag/value pairs to a resource.

Both the tag and the value must already exist.

Related commands:
  mgc tag create                           create the tag first
  mgc tag values create --tag-name <name>  create the value first
